name: causal-sampling-2026-10-19
hypothesis: Equal-probability starts in causally observed severe downtrends, with a broader training universe as a separate factorial axis, may improve directional learning. Test this without future recovery labels.
selection_metric: Equal-weight mean validation net return, unchanged

screen_gate.ranking: Final equal-weight mean return; tie order small_balanced, large_uniform, large_balanced
screen_gate.scope: Promote at most one arm against freshly trained small_uniform. Both stock and ETF final groups must improve or tie. Declining-validation-stock labels never select or promote.

sampling.eligibility: Same global start pool in both modes: feature-row index >=252 and index<len(bars)-21; all configured training episodes must have eligible starts
sampling.condition: Price return over previous252 sessions<-20% AND previous63 sessions<0, evaluated using current available close only
sampling.price_contract: Verified split-adjusted prices; dividends excluded from sampling label and included in simulator equity
sampling.actual_transition_balance: Measured, not assumed; 50% start classes does not force 50% training transitions
sampling.legacy_rng: Default legacy_uniform preserves original random draws; new ready_uniform control intentionally uses the shared readiness pool

constraints.features_actions_costs_reward: Unchanged basic features, target-zone-v1, default simulator, net log equity
constraints.short_side: Reconciled reporting on all symbols; ex-post negative-holding stock labels are reporting-only
constraints.success_claim: Development promotion is not independent confirmation or permission to trade
constraints.source: One frozen committed source for every smoke/screen/confirmation cell; export shares original ledger and allocation lock
constraints.normalization: Each training universe fits its own immutable training-only normalizer; validation bars/features/ATR must match exactly across datasets

execution.preflight: 512-transition CPU smoke for each of four dataset/mode combinations; check actual kernel before dependency setup
execution.cleanup: Retrieve and validate artifacts; verify owned teardown; retain selected/final weights and curves; publish checksums before removing duplicates
